message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Yang1 used online dating to meet Zhao, pretended to be mother, got trust, transferred 71,000 from Zhao's bank card to his own, spent, also bought gold ring for 2541.94. Total 73541.94. He then had a wedding ceremony but no legal marriage, then disappeared. This is classic fraud (诈骗). The amount is 73541.94, which is "数额巨大"? In Chinese law, 10,000-30,000 is relatively large? Actually thresholds: 10,000-30,000 is relatively large; 30,000-100,000 is huge? Let's recall: Under Chinese criminal law, fraud (诈骗罪) thresholds: 1,000-10,000 is small; 10,000-30,000 is relatively large; 30,000-100,000 is huge; over 100,000 is especially huge. So 73k is huge (数额巨大). So crime: 诈骗 (fraud). Possibly also "非法占有"? But the main is fraud. No other crimes like "非法拘禁" etc. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
